entry.name: times
entry.description: Multiplies two numbers together, and outputs the result upon receiving input in the left inlet.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: In right inlet: The number is stored for multiplication with a number received in the left inlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: The number is multiplied by the number in the right inlet, and the result is sent out the outlet.

messages.name: list
messages.description: In left inlet: The first number is multiplied by the second number, and the result is sent out the outlet.

messages.name: set
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the inlet's input without causing output.
